Humanoids

Westlake demonstrates cooperative trouser folding with WR1

New footage shows shared cloth handling and household task sequences.

Pandaily ↗9 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 11

The demonstrated tasks

Pandaily reports October 9 footage showing kitchen-to-bedroom tasks and two humanoids spreading and folding trousers together with dexterous hands.

Whole-body coordination

The company describes world and vision-language-action models generating coordinated sequences, with GAE handling motion execution and balance across hand and body movements.

What the footage cannot establish

Cooperative cloth handling is challenging, but the report provides no independently verified success rate or long-term deployment results. The world-first description remains a company claim.
